summary: Phase 2 Vision-autofill re-test (backend only, iteration 11). All 4 previously-reported blockers are FIXED and verified live: (1) Vision autofill now works via ImageContent(image_base64=...) + anthropic/claude-sonnet-5 — real extraction from a Turkish tapu PNG returned 8 correct konut fields; (2) stream_message + StreamDone.usage gives real token counts (in=1273/out=235 image, in=1052/out=242 PDF); (3) PDF path works via pypdf text extraction (no renderer needed); (4) LLM failures now return HTTP 400 with a JSON body (verified with a real Anthropic 'image exceeds 10 MB' provider error) and the 5 TL hold is refunded. MAX_ATTACHMENTS=10 cap works (11 -> 400 'En fazla 10 dosya', no charge; exactly 10 passes the cap). Wallet reconciliation exact: wallet decremented by exactly cost_try, never negative; usage_events mode='autofill' has input/output tokens, actual_ai_cost_try>0, file_count=1 and cost == max(actual*1.30, 1.0). Extended /app/backend/tests/test_autofill_phase2.py from 21 to 28 tests -> 28/28 pass. Regression: 76/76 baseline (admin/kb/rbac + email/resend + invite/baseurl) pass; Phase 1b token counting + scope guard + max_tokens=1024 cap (output_tokens exactly 1024) still pass. 4 real LLM calls total. All test data cleaned; wallets restored to 500/150 TL.

minor.issue: TEMP FILE LEAK on every non-success branch. Downloaded attachments are only unlinked in the success path, so an LLM failure (400) leaves the full-size file on disk (reproduced: a 20 MB PNG left at generated_reports/{chat_id}/_autofill/). The 'Analiz edilebilir görsel/PDF eki bulunamadı' branch also leaves the empty _autofill and parent chat directory behind (found 22 stale dirs). Fix: wrap the whole flow in try/finally and shutil.rmtree(tmp_dir, ignore_errors=True). Regression test added: TestAutofillSafeguards::test_llm_failure_returns_400_not_502 (currently FAILS only on this leak assertion).

No file-size limit: a 20 MB PNG is accepted and stored, then fails downstream at the provider. Add a max upload size (and reject images > Anthropic's 10 MB base64 / 8000px limits early with a clear Turkish message instead of surfacing the raw litellm exception text to the user).

Corrupt/unsupported image bytes are silently skipped inside _claude_vision_extract (logger.warning only) — image_contents ends up empty but files_analyzed still reports the file count and the user is still charged for a text-only, hallucination-prone call. Should fail with 400 (and refund) when no content block could be built.

Negative-balance guard is effectively unreachable and untestable end-to-end: NOMINAL_HOLD=5 TL is already required up front, so a wallet of 1 TL gets 402 before the call, and the delta path only triggers when actual charge > 5 TL (needs a very large call). Guard logic itself is correct (atomic find_one_and_update with wallet_balance >= extra, else charge capped at NOMINAL_HOLD) — verified by code assertion test, not by live traffic.
Payload is still a raw Dict[str, Any] (no Pydantic model); attachment_ids items are not validated as strings and documented min_balance_ok is never read.
server.py is 2369 lines (>700 guideline). chats message/autofill/fields should move to a dedicated router module.
Still failing on stale absolute expectations (usage-event count / exact balance) after usage_events cleanup — not product defects; assertions should be relative.

action_items: Clean up the autofill temp directory in a finally block (shutil.rmtree) so failure branches don't leak files/dirs — only remaining defect found this iteration.
Add an upload size/dimension guard (images > 10 MB base64 or > 8000px) with a friendly Turkish error instead of proxying the raw litellm/Anthropic message.
Return 400 + refund when no image/PDF content block could actually be built (corrupt image currently charged as a text-only call).
Optional: convert autofill/fields payloads to Pydantic models and split server.py into routers.
critical_code_review_comments: Vision path verified end-to-end: image -> PIL normalize to PNG -> ImageContent(base64) -> claude-sonnet-5 stream_message; usage read from StreamDone; 8/13 konut fields extracted correctly from the synthetic tapu image and 8 from the PDF text path.
Charging model verified: cost_try = max(actual_usd * 42 * 1.30, 1.0); small calls hit the 1 TL floor, hold reconciled by refunding 4 TL, wallet_balance in the response equals live /auth/me.

Error/refund coverage verified: empty ids, missing key, non-image MIME, unknown id, other user's attachment, 402 insufficient balance, >10 attachments, provider error — all 400/402 with the 5 TL hold fully refunded.

PATCH /chats/{id}/fields (merge, clear[], empty-value removal, 404s) and POST /chats/{id}/message SSE (scope guard, real token write-back matching $2/$10 per 1M and USD_TRY=42, output_tokens capped at exactly 1024) all still pass.

rca_of_the_issue: Temp leak RCA: the unlink loop + tmp_dir.rmdir() sit at the very end of autofill_chat_from_attachments, after every HTTPException raise point, so any early exit (no analyzable file, missing template, LLM error) skips cleanup entirely; the LLM-error branch is the worst case because files were already downloaded (20 MB reproduced). Fix is a try/finally with shutil.rmtree(tmp_dir, ignore_errors=True).
